comment: The interaction matrix of the Atmospheres verification (master plan 9.1, stage 3). Template: a package adds its rows under "rows" and its player rows under "player_rows"; the EXPECTED effect of a row is written here BEFORE it is measured. Axes: the feature on or off, the other mods (EVE, Scatterer, Deferred, TUFX), the upscaler, frame generation and raytracing. "baseline" is the row every effect is measured against and runs first. Rows are restricted to a non-zero expected effect that needs a mod set change (the mod set is the eve, scatterer, deferred and tufx values); `python tools/atmo_ab.py interaction expand tests/series/interaction-matrix.json [--cover]` prints the order, `... judge <matrix> <measured.json>` compares a measured table (row id -> metric -> value) with the expectations and prints every deviation. Effects: increase | decrease | change | none; min and max bound the size of the effect (measured minus baseline, or the value itself with absolute true). "player_rows" are the rows the weather player runs itself (L2, python tools/build_weather_player.py --series interaction-player): the player arguments, whether the proxy is beside it, and the expected figure per metric as [known value, relative tolerance, absolute floor] or {"same_as": row id, "rel": tolerance}. The known values are the spike's (.local/plans/spike-result.md: the camera turn at 25 km, render scale 0.667 unless the id says 0.5). Frame generation and raytracing rows need the game and live in "rows".

rows.note: the feature alone, EVE as renderer: the difference region is the volume's contribution
without EVE the own volume pass draws the clouds; its contribution share rises
no atmospheric scattering changes the sky the volume is composed over

temporal error rises by the slab's share: the spike's DLSS K run with the slab is 0.0123 against 0.0026 for FSR 3 without it (baseline), so about 0.01; the minimum is a fifth of that, well above the 0.0003 floor of the figure
generated frames: trail pixels rise with the slab (spike: 0.085 with DLSS K against 0.008 for FSR 3 without it) but stay below 0.2; the minimum is far above the 0.003 floor of the figure
with the volume in the raytracing input the pass cost rises (the minimum 0.05 ms is above the timestamp noise [VERIFY on the first run]) and stays within gate G3
